label: EWSR1::CREB1
tumor_contexts: Intracranial mesenchymal tumor with FET::CREB fusion

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
CREB1 encodes a cyclic-AMP-responsive transcription factor.

The fusion combines a FET-family activation region with a CREB-family DNA-binding region, producing abnormal transcriptional activation. EWSR1::CREB1 is a recognized fusion in angiomatoid fibrous histiocytoma.
